question: Three resistors of 10 Ω, 15 Ω and 30 Ω are connected in series. The resistance of the combination is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**55Ω**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The total resistance (R) of resistors connected in series is calculated by adding the individual resistances:
 
 
• R = R1 + R2 + R3
 
 
 
• In this case, R1 = 10 Ω, R2 = 15 Ω, and R3 = 30 Ω.
 
• So, R = 10 Ω + 15 Ω + 30 Ω = 55 Ω
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **3) 55 Ω**.
